newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-SANTOS RETURNS TO BRAZIL ON LOAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SANTOS RETURNS TO BRAZIL ON LOAN.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam defender Marcio Santos is to return to his native Brazil on loan to Atletico Mineiro, the Dutch ANP news agency said on Wednesday.

Santos, a member of Brazil's 1994 World Cup winning squad, has been unable to command a regular first-team slot at Ajax and last month set an unenviable record for the fastest sending-off in Dutch history -- just 17 seconds after coming on as a substitute.
ANP said Santos, who signed for Ajax in 1995, would join the Brazilian club from January 15, with the loan period running to July 31.
